Dear Priya,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to confirm our dinner meeting scheduled for May 24, 2024, at 19:00 at The Gourmet Restaurant. The dinner is planned to run until 21:00.

Please let me know if this time and location still work for you and the team from Bilgen Corp.

We look forward to discussing our future collaboration over dinner.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
